The '''Ruins of Carnuss Gorgull''' was a place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] which, some time after being abandoned, eventually got turned into a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] track. As of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the track favorite was the [[Ghishi (species)|Ghishi]] [[Podracer (profession)|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kraid Nemmeso]], who held record lap and race times.<ref name="Racer" />
